system.description:
When you take this Sorcerous Tradition, you also gain this feature for free. You made a contract with an otherworldly daemon, jailing it inside you in exchange for power and the possibility of release. You begin with 3 Favour, to a maximum of 7.

During a Rest, you may use a Downtime Action to parley with your dieva. If you do, gain Favour equal to your Charm. If you do not parley, the GM gains Fear equal to 7 minus your current Favour.

  • When your Favour reaches 7, roll Wits (15). On a failure, your Dieva seizes control briefly but to devastating effect; the GM will describes the consequences of your actions.
  • If your Favour drops to 0, your Dieva withholds its power. Until you fulfil a horrendous task it demands, you cannot regain Favour or make use of its magic.
  • If you die without the Dieva playing a direct part in the events, it escapes and is loosed upon the world.
